description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) that returns (float, dict). Addresses signal quality weakness: only 4 distinct values currently, needs to discriminate across a broader range. Uses metadata fields: permission_scope, registry_source, age_days, dependency_count, publisher_verified, tool_count, request_strategy. Computes granular permission risk scores (READ vs WRITE vs ADMIN), scope breadth penalties, and temporal decay. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Completes in <2s per call. Returns evidence dict with partial scores per field for audit.
